title: Local Inference Test Bench leaderboard transport shard
description: One independently bounded page of globally ranked leaderboard entries under the logical schema named by the transport envelope.
$comment: index_version remains 1.0 because the transport did not change. schema_version binds all rows to either the frozen unannotated 1.0 branch or the explicit mixed 1.1 branch. The Python builder and browser also bind entry_count to the array length, shard_id to the synthesized ordinal filename, and the complete shard bytes to the per-file publication cap.
